# schemas

One JSON file per template. Keys: `id`, `version`, `name`, `shortName`, `organ`, `specimenNoun`, `maxParts`, `defaultParts`, `generator`, `style`, `caseFields`, `options`, `partDefaults`, `fields`, `example`.

Field types: `text`, `textarea`, `number` (`min`, `step`, `suffix`), `checkbox`, `select` / `grade` (`options`, `optionLabels`, `optionsByField`, `showIf`, `defaultForFirstPart`).

Templates: `gastric_biopsy`, `colonic_polyp`, `prostate_biopsy`, `ibd_biopsy`, `oesophageal_biopsy`, `frozen_section`, `breast_biopsy` (generated by `node scripts/build-breast-schema.mjs`, which pulls the biomarker fields from `generators/breast_biomarkers.js` — edit the script, not the JSON).
